format: core WebAssembly module, wasm32, no component model, no WASI
rules: Any import outside import_module hsearch_host_v1 refuses the module at link time
Any export outside this list is ignored; any missing export refuses the module
The module exports at most one memory; it is not shared and has a maximum declared
The input region holds point id bytes then input bytes; the output region holds the result; each is io_bytes long and owned by the guest
A WASM call is never concurrent within one instance; max_concurrent_calls is realised as that many instances, so memory is up to max_concurrent_calls times the per-instance limit
HS_E_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL from a WASM module is final: the regions are fixed, so the host refuses with a limit error and never retries; io_bytes must not exceed HS_MAX_BUFFER_BYTES
hs_abi_version returns an i32 holding the same (major << 16) | minor value as the C u32
